name: kleandeck-e2e
description: End-to-end browser tests for the Kleandeck site and admin.

scripts.stack:up: docker compose -p kleandeck-e2e -f ../compose.yml -f compose.e2e.yml --env-file e2e.env up -d --build --wait
scripts.stack:down: docker compose -p kleandeck-e2e -f ../compose.yml -f compose.e2e.yml --env-file e2e.env down -v
scripts.stack:logs: docker compose -p kleandeck-e2e -f ../compose.yml -f compose.e2e.yml --env-file e2e.env logs --tail 100
scripts.e2e: npm run stack:down && npm run stack:up && npm test
